ambiguities_or_notes: Exact audited Russian Markdown source bytes were revalidated in this runtime against the pinned SHA-256.
All three printed page markers, both dated portions (17 and 18 April), the numbered eleven-point study plan, and all twenty apparatus notes are represented.

всестороннее развитие is kept repeatedly as all-round development, and всего существующего as everything that exists, preserving the young Tolstoy's recurrent philosophical vocabulary rather than substituting later abstractions.
помещичьей is rendered the life of a landowner; юридических наук remains juridical sciences and Гимназический курс remains the Gymnasium course in its historical educational sense.
The abrupt final Не исполнил правила is retained as Did not follow the rule, without explanatory smoothing.
Truncated deleted strings и спо, дыша, and Муз зат are represented as cautious English fragments rather than silently completed into fully certain words.
